mission_08: Impressive! You have built a comprehensive text augmentation pipeline that combines four powerful strategies into a unified class. Synonym replacement, random insertion, random swap, and random deletion each introduce different types of linguistic variation, and together they form the EDA (Easy Data Augmentation) framework. This modular design allows you to apply individual strategies or combine them probabilistically for maximum diversity. The class-based approach makes it easy to extend with new strategies like back-translation or paraphrasing. This pipeline is directly applicable to real-world NLP tasks and can dramatically improve model performance on small datasets by artificially expanding the training corpus with meaningful variations.
